# Wait for localized task text after saving the event dialog

1110 registers L10nMutationsFinished on the main document before the dialog callback edits/saves the task, then awaits it before checking the Needs Action text in the details pane. Setting a Fluent ID or closing the dialog is not the completed translation. This applies the existing localization-wait lesson to task detail updates; the accepted test keeps that ordering. The event is document-wide, so it is not by itself an element-specific readiness proof beyond this task's checked sequence.

Scope: Task detail Fluent mutation completion.
